content:
toni: Heads-up: discovered a nasty ordering/shape mismatch in the sampleapp rerank path when retries kick in. Repro with Node/TSC helper when batch >= 6 and one shard falls back.

toni: Minimal repro snippet (Node v0.10.0):
```js
// quicksend.js
const ids = docs.map((d,i)=>d.id||`d${i}`);
const vectors = docs.map(d => padTo(d.vec, 1024)); // model expects 1024
await client.rerank.batch({ model: 'sim-rerank-1024', body: {ids, vectors} });
```

toni: Observed: server returns an `ids` array but on the client retry path we re-map by original index; when the runtime falls back and reorders for perf the final ranking no longer matches the docs. Customers see top-k wrong.

renee: Do we include idempotency keys in the helper? If not, retries may be treated as new independent requests and the runtime can reorder.

tonI: The helper used to set a per-batch idempotency header but a refactor in 0.9.x moved it into the transport layer and the retry shim bypasses it. So sometimes no x-idempotency-key is sent on retry.

maria: I also repro'd a related vector-shape problem: if padTo returns fewer numbers it currently fills with `null` which the runtime coerces to 0 on one shard and throws `vector length mismatch` on another — causing heterogeneous shard errors and triggering fallback ordering.

renee: Two-pronged plan: 1) SDK change - always attach x-idempotency-key and persist it across retries; 2) Batch helper change - validate vectors pre-send (length, numeric, no NaN/null) and, on response, prefer an explicit ids->score mapping, only fall back to index mapping if ids are absent.

toni: I'll open a fast-follow patch to the Node helper that: generates uuid per batch, attaches header, and maps results by returned ids. Also emits a debug error like "bad_vec: id=foo len=1016 expected=1024 - found nulls".

maria: For DX, update sampleapp quickstart to show the idempotency header in the production note (keep examples short but include a one-line comment). We should also add a tiny comment in the JS helper explaining why we match by ids.

ci-bot: Action items: create SDK bug (DX-4319), add unit tests for id-based mapping (node/python/rust), add quick CI rerank burst job (100 reqs) to sampleapp smoke tests.

renee: I'll add a failing test in the SDK parity suite that simulates the runtime returning reordered ids on retry. Expectation: SDK maps by id and retains correct doc->score mapping.

toni: Short-term hotfix: reduce default retries to 1 for rerank batch in Node and widen backoff; long-term: make batch retries idempotent by default.

maria: Also worth noting: when we log validation errors include the offending doc id and the first 8 vector values. Saves debugging time.

toni: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/1488 (draft) - patch includes idempotency header and id->score mapping + unit tests. Assigning to @renee for review.

renee: Will review tomorrow. Thanks for catching this before the customer call. :raised_hands:
